item.title: Stanford Live Celebrates 250 Years of American Voices
item.description:
Stanford Live Celebrates 250 Years of American Voices

Stanford Live launches a season that honors the United States’ 250th anniversary by featuring artists whose stories reflect the nation’s layered, diverse narrative.

📅 Upcoming Events

  • Upcoming Events
  • Discover tomorrow’s stars, today

🎭 Artistic Focus

  • Many of the featured composers and performers arrived in the United States from elsewhere, became citizens, and chose to build their new creative home here.
  • In illuminating these artists, we endeavor to honor the layered, diverse, and continually unfolding American story.

📣 In the Media

  • Iris Nemani is Keeping Stanford Live in Play
  • From her path to Stanford Live and vision for its future, Iris Nemani talks to Jim Harrington at The San Jose Mercury News.
  • READ IN THE MERCURY NEWS

🎓 Student & Campus Engagement

  • Stanford Live connects students and the community to the performing arts through free and discounted tickets, masterclasses and workshops, and work opportunities.
  • Explore programs that open doors to creativity and discovery.

🙋 Get Involved

  • Explore Our American Story
  • Get Involved

item.title: GCU Hosts Cheer Camp for K‑8 Students with Clinic and Showcase
item.description:
GCU Hosts Cheer Camp for K‑8 Students with Clinic and Showcase

Grand Canyon University (GCU) hosted a Cheer Camp for K‑8th graders, featuring a clinic and a showcase that welcomed parents.

🎉 Overview

  • Cheer camp designed for kindergarten through 8th‑grade students.
  • Included a clinic and a showcase.
  • Parents were invited to attend.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Who Can Attend

  • Students in grades K‑8.
  • Their families and parents.

⚙️ Clinic Activities

  • Instruction led by the GCU Dance Team and GCU Cheerleaders.
  • Turns, kicks, and leaps.
  • Game day chants.
  • Tumbling and stunting.
  • Parade‑style dance motions.

📅 Event Flow

  • Clinic instruction took place first.
  • Following this there will be a spirit activity.
  • The event concluded with a showcase open to parents.

#cheerleading #community #GCU #familyevent

Source: Events Archive - GCU News
